description: This file defines the Zend_Http_UserAgent class, which manages user agent detection, configuration, and storage within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for serialization, device class loading, user agent matching, and plugin loader management.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent
classes.description: Main class for detecting, configuring, and managing user agent information, including device detection, serialization, and plugin loader management.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns a serialized string representing the current user agent object, including device class, configuration, and server info.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Restores the user agent object state from a serialized string, reconstructing device and configuration.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Configures the user agent object with provided options, including server variables, plugin loaders, and detection parameters.

methods.name: _match
methods.description: Checks if a given device class matches the current user agent string.

methods.name: _getUserAgentDevice
methods.description: Loads and returns the class name for a device type based on configuration or plugin loader.

methods.name: getUserAgent
methods.description: Retrieves the current user agent string from server variables or default.

methods.name: setUserAgent
methods.description: Sets the user agent string in server variables.

methods.name: getHttpAccept
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP Accept header value or default.

methods.name: setHttpAccept
methods.description: Sets the HTTP Accept header value.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage handler, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Sets the persistent storage handler.

methods.name: clearStorage
methods.description: Clears the persistent storage for a given browser.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration array.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Merges and sets new configuration parameters.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Returns the device object representing detected device capabilities.

methods.name: getBrowserType
methods.description: Returns the current detected browser type.

methods.name: setBrowserType
methods.description: Sets the browser type, if object is mutable.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns the server variables array.

methods.name: setServer
methods.description: Sets the server variables array.

methods.name: getServerValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific server variable value.

methods.name: setServerValue
methods.description: Sets a specific server variable value.

methods.name: setPluginLoader
methods.description: Configures a plugin loader for storage or device types.

methods.name: getPluginLoader
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin loader for a given type, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: _validateLoaderType
methods.description: Validates and normalizes plugin loader type.

methods.name: _matchUserAgent
methods.description: Runs the detection sequence to identify the correct browser type based on user agent string.

methods.name: _createDevice
methods.description: Instantiates the device object based on detected browser type.
